troubleshooting: No output: Ensure ZED camera is connected and ZED TOP is cooking
Windows only: ZED POP requires Microsoft Windows
Memory issues: Reduce Maximum Memory or Resolution
Mesh quality: Increase Filter level for smoother results
description: Uses ZED StereoLabs SDK to scan and create geometry meshes or point clouds from depth camera data. Supports live spatial mapping with mesh reconstruction, filtering, and normals. Windows only. Requires ZED TOP for input data.
